caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object composed primarily of two vertically oriented, symmetrical components joined at the top by a horizontal bar. These components are mostly silver-gray in color with decorative engraved patterns and embossed circular motifs. Each side has a semicircular toothed or gear-like shape, as well as additional curved and ornate details. At the upper section, there are two rings through which copper-colored rods are threaded, leading toward the center where a darker, hook-like piece is situated between the two rings. At the bottom of each vertical element, there are short metallic chains hanging downward, each consisting of several interlocking oval links. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white color. The artist's signature, "Arthur E Reynolds," is present in small text near the bottom right of the image.
title: Bit
